subject: OptiHealth hosted-integration: technical architecture handshake and deep-dive
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optihealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: OptiHealth hosted-integration: technical architecture handshake and deep-dive

Hi Samira —

Great to reconnect after last week's discovery. The OptiHealth engineering team raised a few architecture questions around the Hosted API integration (streaming + SDKs + tool/function calling) that we should walk through together. To keep this focused, proposed agenda:

- 15m: Introductions & goals for the integration (team roles, success criteria)
- 30m: Hosted API connection patterns (auth, routing, and fallback)
- 30m: SDKs + streaming best practices (continuous vs. chunked streaming, client reconnection)
- 20m: Tool/function-calling patterns and security boundaries (webhook patterns, callback reliability)
- 15m: Open Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

Can we target Wednesday 2027-08-04 between 10:00–12:00 PT? I can send a calendar invite and attach a short agenda + SDK checklist.

Attachments: redwood-optihealth-arch-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@optihealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai, OptiHealth Platform Team <devops@optihealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:26:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: OptiHealth hosted-integration: technical architecture handshake and deep-dive

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Wednesday works for our engineering leads, but we have a conflict at 10:30 PT with an internal release window. Would you be able to start at 11:00 PT instead and go until 12:30 PT? Also, could you include a short section on expected telemetry (per-route latency/cost breakdown) so our SRE can evaluate observability impact?

We can bring two folks: myself and Mateo R. (platform).

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Eng, OptiHealth
samira.khan@optihealth.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OptiHealth hosted-integration: technical architecture handshake and deep-dive

Hannah — quick internal note:

If we shift to 11:00 PT I'm available. For the agenda, I recommend we add a 10-minute demo of the SDK auto-reconnect behavior (node + python) and a short run-through of streaming chunk sizes and the KV cache implications for prompt windows — OptiHealth mentioned long patient-context sequences, so we'll need to show memory/latency tradeoffs.

I'll attach the SDK streaming checklist before we send the invite (sdk-streaming-checklist.xlsx). Also propose we include a link to a short Eval that surfaced regression risks when moving to quantized variants.

— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime

Thanks Samira — 11:00–12:30 PT on Wed 2027-08-04 is confirmed. I’ve included Mateo on the invite and copied our SRE/Runtime lead (Karthik) and SDK engineer (Chloe). Grace from customer success will join the first 10 minutes to capture the mutual action plan.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=opti-deepdive-20270803

SDK streaming checklist: sdk-streaming-checklist.xlsx
Drive prep deck: https://drive.google.com/redwood/opti/arch-briefing
HubSpot record: HS-OPTI-0042

Meeting agenda highlights (copied into invite):
- Goals & participants (5m)
- Connection/auth patterns + routing/fallback (20m)
- SDK streaming demo & best practices (25m)
- Function/tool-calling architecture + webhook reliability (20m)
- Observability: per-route latency & cost breakdown (15m)
- Next steps & action items (5m)

Please reply if you'd like us to add any specific logs/metrics you want to review (trace samples, token-cost per request).

Attachments: redwood-optihealth-arch-agenda.pdf, sdk-streaming-checklist.xlsx

See you Wed —
Hannah
